relationships.subject: MR-guided focused ultrasound
relationships.evidence_quote: MRgFUS can also be applied to a brain target after intravenous delivery of microbubbles to create cavitations and focally open the blood-brain barrier (BBB).

key_findings: MRgFUS with microbubbles transiently opens the BBB, shown safe and feasible in Alzheimer's patients.
BBB opening enables noninvasive delivery of chemotherapies, immunotherapies, gene and cell therapies.
